hypothesis: Generating questions one-at-a-time, each conditioned on the already-asked set, should push the 3B off its modal cluster into the task-specific tail of its distribution — because forcing explicit novelty relative to prior questions is a different generation dynamic than emitting all 7 at once and collapsing onto the generic center.
technique: An 8-call RAG-grounded pipeline: 1 framing call followed by 7 sequential question calls, each shown the already-asked set in-context and instructed to probe a genuinely different unknown, built on the exp003 RAG few-shot base.
